ENV_FILE="/opt/ava/.env"

SC="systemctl --user"

# Load environment variables if file exists
if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    set -a
    source "$ENV_FILE"
    set +a
fi

function start_agent() {
    # SELF-KILL GUARD
    MACH6_PID=$(pgrep -f "daemon.js.*$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [ -n "$MACH6_PID" ]; then
      CHECK_PID=$PPID
      while [ "$CHECK_PID" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null; do
        if [ "$CHECK_PID" = "$MACH6_PID" ]; then

        CHECK_PID=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$CHECK_PID" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || echo 0)
      done
    fi

    echo "▶️  Starting Mach6 Agent..."
    # Kill any orphan processes first
    pkill -9 -f "daemon.js.*$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
    pkill -9 -f "$STACK_MANAGER" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 1

    else

      tail -n 20 /tmp/mach6.log
    fi

    pkill -9 -f "daemon.js.*$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
